topic: Unveiling the Riemann Zeta Function: From Simple Sums to the Mystery of Primes
target_audience: University students or advanced high school students with an interest in mathematics

sections.title: Prerequisite: The Concept of Infinite Series
lecture_lines: Imagine adding an infinite list of numbers together.
A runner covers half of a one-meter path.
Next, they cover half of the remaining gap.
The bar fills as the runner continues forever.
This infinite process reaches a finite total of one.
animations: Show a sequence of fractions 1/2, 1/4, 1/8... in white (#FFFFFF).
Display a white bar (#FFFFFF) representing a target length of 1 meter.
A green runner icon (#00FF00) moves across the bar, filling it yellow (#FFFF00) until it hits 1.

sections.title: Defining the Riemann Zeta Function
lecture_lines: The Zeta function sums reciprocal powers of integers.
We raise each denominator to the power of 's'.
Changing 's' controls how fast the terms shrink.
For 's' equals two, the sum equals pi squared over six.
This famous result connects integers to the geometry of circles.
animations: Show the formula ζ(s) = Σ (1/n^s) in large white text (#FFFFFF).
Highlight the exponent 's' in the formula with yellow (#FFFF00).
Show terms 1/1², 1/2², 1/3²... in cyan (#00FFFF) shrinking at a specific rate.
Animate yellow sparks (#FFFF00) falling and gathering to form a magenta circle (#FF00FF).
Display the result π²/6 in white (#FFFFFF) next to the completed circle.

sections.title: The Boundary: Convergence vs. Divergence
lecture_lines: The series fails to converge when 's' is small.
At 's' equals one, the harmonic sum grows infinitely.
We visualize 's' as points on a complex grid.
animations: Show 1 + 1/2 + 1/3... (#FFFFFF) with terms represented by green blocks (#00FF00).
The green blocks grow past the top of the screen.
Display a complex grid (#FFFFFF) with a red point flashing (#FF0000) at s=1.

sections.title: Analytic Continuation: The Secret Bridge
lecture_lines: A flashlight illuminates one side of a hidden puzzle.
Analytic continuation reveals the rest of the image.
The pieces match perfectly to form a single map.
animations: A curve (#FFFFFF) crosses a dashed blue vertical boundary (#0000FF).
A yellow puzzle piece (#FFFF00) snaps into a gray grid (#888888).
A yellow spotlight (#FFFF00) illuminates a mathematical formula on the right.
The spotlight grows to illuminate the left side in cyan (#00FFFF).
The patterns on both sides flash white (#FFFFFF) in unison.

sections.title: The Ghostly Result: ζ(-1) = -1/12
lecture_lines: In the extended domain, we find shocking new values.
The sum of all natural numbers maps to negative twelfth.
This result appears as a dip in the function's landscape.
animations: Show a divergent sum 1 + 2 + 3 + 4... in white (#FFFFFF).
Overlay a cyan 'Magic Lens' (#00FFFF) that changes the sum to -1/12 (#FF0000).
The -1/12 value settles into a 2D grid (#FFFFFF) representing the landscape.

sections.title: The Golden Link: Primes and the Euler Product
lecture_lines: Zeta reveals a deep connection to prime numbers.
It can be written as a product of all primes.
This formula encodes the distribution of primes like DNA.
animations: Display a cloud of prime numbers (2, 3, 5, 7...) as cyan musical notes (#00FFFF).
Arrange the notes into the Euler Product formula in yellow (#FFFF00).
Transform the product formula into a twisting green DNA helix (#00FF00).

sections.title: The Million Dollar Mystery: The Riemann Hypothesis
lecture_lines: The function's zeros hide a million-dollar mathematical secret.
All non-trivial zeros seem to lie on one line.
This critical line has a real part of one half.
Proving this would unlock the secrets of prime distribution.
This remains the greatest unsolved mystery in mathematics.
animations: Display a complex plane with yellow gold coins (#FFFF00) scattered as zeros.
A vertical red tightrope (#FF0000) appears, and the coins move onto it.
Label the tightrope as 'Re(s) = 1/2' in white text (#FFFFFF).
A green $1,000,000 prize tag (#00FF00) drops down next to the line.
The entire red line glows with intense white light (#FFFFFF).
